environment.timing_limits: Shared host; alternating paired runs, no discarded samples. Initialization, hashing and file I/O are excluded from the native timing metric.

profile.purpose: Diagnostic hotspot selection only; instrumented times are not production benchmark samples.
profile.exit_instrumentation: A diagnostic-only linker wrapper flushes profiling data immediately before the verifier's intentional _exit; production teardown is unchanged.

attempts.reason: Verifier intentionally exits without automatic profiling cleanup

experiments.comparison: Every verifier JSON field agrees after excluding only native_seconds_excluding_file_io and binary_sha256; raw receipt hashes and all samples are retained below.
Every verifier JSON field agrees after excluding only native_seconds_excluding_file_io and binary_sha256; raw receipt hashes and all samples are retained below.

validation.limits: Same-source execution/fingerprint agreement and focused native-reference tests do not independently prove every physics field or retail equivalence. The reference gate remains failed at 106/108.

additional_planning_diagnostic.selection: Training-only diagnostic on an already frozen story workload; one pair, separate from the three-repetition native timing experiment.
additional_planning_diagnostic.limit: Includes exact-prefix reconstruction. One diagnostic pair is not a general end-to-end solver speed guarantee.

cost_accounting.limit: Corpus verified_rows excludes rejected captures; those executions are not free. The scope CPU sample includes build, benchmark and corpus work. API calls, captured calculations, native timing and scope CPU use different units and are not summed as one measure.

decision.adopted: Exact callback-local empty cancel-region proof in the ordinary Release build
decision.ipo: A separate unchanged-source experiment improves native timing by about 9 percent; it is not enabled by default and its gain is not combined with the cache measurements.
decision.next_constraint: Whole solver search costs remain substantial; the native speedup is not an equal whole-run planning speedup.
